scope: 253 French expression entries: 95 existing specifications plus 158 additions. Editorial common-expression inventory, not a claim of every French idiom.

integration.exercise: Checkboxes: Verbs / Expressions / Verbs with pronoun replacement. Multiple selections rotate through compatible families. Choices are included in saved/shared presets.
integration.groups: Editorial metadata only; not exercise modes
integration.topic_selection: A selected base verb admits its expressions; selected expression headwords are also accepted. Topic membership is inherited, not separately semantically curated.
integration.frequency: Expressions have independent approximate editorial ranks in frequency.json and use the same cumulative Top N controls as verbs.
integration.word_families: Each expression has a record explicitly linked to the base verb family. This is not a claim that every listed derivative shares the full idiom meaning.
integration.conjugation: All seven existing app tenses. Explicit feminine forms; subject restrictions for nonpersonal constructions; avoir override for transitive passer expressions.
integration.filter_verification: Browser check passed after crash recovery: expression-only cards, Conjugation label, reload persistence and single-verb filtering.
integration.fill_blanks: Hidden by FILL_BLANKS_VISIBLE; implementation, decks and saved legacy drills retained.
